verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation, and community users corroborate it hands-on by prompting Dream Machine directly. For iterating without starting over, it lists Draft Mode (cheap 360p passes), video-to-video with keyframes, Multi-Keyframe direction, and Modify Video V2, which reshapes existing footage. Community reports of uneven output quality and difficulty matching the demos concern result quality, not the capability itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of refining or extending a previously generated clip in place (e.g., remix or extend of a prior generation, or prompt-revision history), and independent hands-on corroboration of the iteration features specifically.
